name: Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy (NMR & EPR)
summary: The theory and practice of pulsed NMR and EPR, from spin physics to multidimensional and solid-state experiments.

topics.name: Nuclear spin, the Zeeman interaction and the vector model
Bloch equations, relaxation (T1, T2) and the rotating frame
Pulsed Fourier-transform NMR and the product-operator formalism
Theory of chemical shift and J-coupling
Dynamic NMR, chemical exchange and the nuclear Overhauser effect
Solid-state NMR: magic-angle spinning and cross-polarization
EPR: g-values, hyperfine coupling and pulsed EPR
